855-clocks.title: Clocks
855-clocks.creator: Jerome K. Jerome
855-clocks.description: A book by Jerome K. Jerome. As for the other class of clocks--the common or always-wrong clocks--they are harmless enough. You wind them up at the proper intervals, and once or twice a week you put them right and "regulate" them, as you call it (and you might just as well try to "regulate" a London tom-cat). But you do all this, not from any selfish motives, but from a sense of duty to the clock itself.

arxiv-1910-01545.title: On Universal Approximation by Neural Networks with Uniform Guarantees on Approximation of Infinite Dimensional Maps
arxiv-1910-01545.creator: William H. Guss wguss@cs.cmu.edu, Ruslan Salakhutdinov rsalakhu@cs.cmu.edu
arxiv-1910-01545.description: Abstract The study of universal approximation of arbitrary functions f : 𝒳 → 𝒴 f:{\mathcal{X}}\to{\mathcal{Y}} by neural networks has a rich and thorough history dating back to Kolmogorov 1957 . In the case of learning finite dimensional maps, many authors have shown various forms of the universality of both fixed depth and fixed width neural networks.

arxiv-2107-01562.title: Random Neural Networks in the Infinite Width Limit as Gaussian Processes
arxiv-2107-01562.creator: Boris Hanin
arxiv-2107-01562.description: Abstract This article gives a new proof that fully connected neural networks with random weights and biases converge to Gaussian processes in the regime where the input dimension, output dimension, and depth are kept fixed, while the hidden layer widths tend to infinity.

arxiv-2108-05820.title: On networks with order close to the Moore bound Journal: Graphs and Combinatorics
arxiv-2108-05820.creator: James Tuite, Grahame Erskine
arxiv-2108-05820.description: Abstract The degree/diameter problem for mixed graphs asks for the largest possible order of a mixed graph with given diameter and degree parameters. Similarly the degree/geodecity problem concerns the smallest order of a k k -geodetic mixed graph with given minimum undirected and directed degrees; this is a generalisation of the classical degree/girth problem.

arxiv-2204-10050.title: SemEval-2022 Task 2: Multilingual Idiomaticity Detection and Sentence Embedding
arxiv-2204-10050.creator: Harish Tayyar Madabushi, Edward Gow-Smith, Marcos Garcia, Carolina Scarton, Marco Idiart, Aline Villavicencio, [0.3cm] University of Sheffield, UK
arxiv-2204-10050.description: Abstract This paper presents the shared task on Multilingual Idiomaticity Detection and Sentence Embedding , which consists of two Subtasks: (a) a binary classification task aimed at identifying whether a sentence contains an idiomatic expression, and (b) a task based on semantic text similarity which requires the model to adequately represent potentially idiomatic expressions in context.

arxiv-2302-04319.title: Optimal Allocation of Many Robot Guards for Sweep-Line Coverage
arxiv-2302-04319.creator: Si Wei FengTeng Guo, Jingjin Yu
arxiv-2302-04319.description: Abstract We study the problem of allocating many mobile robots for the execution of a pre-defined sweep schedule in a known two-dimensional environment, with applications toward search and rescue, coverage, surveillance, monitoring, pursuit-evasion, and so on. The mobile robots (or agents) are assumed to have one-dimensional sensing capability with probabilistic guarantees that deteriorate as the sensing distance increases.

arxiv-2310-20257.title: Diophantine conditions in the law of the iterated logarithm for lacunary systems
arxiv-2310-20257.creator: Christoph Aistleitner, Lorenz Frühwirth, Joscha Prochno
arxiv-2310-20257.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christoph Aistleitner, Lorenz Frühwirth, Joscha Prochno. It is a classical observation that lacunary function systems exhibit many properties which are typical for systems of independent random variables. However, it had already been observed by Erdős and Fortet in the 1950s that probability theory’s limit theorems may fail for lacunary sums ∑ f ⁡ ( n k ​ x ) \sum f(n_{k}x) if the sequence ( n k ) k ≥ 1 (n_{k})_{k\geq 1} has a strong arithmetic “structure”.

arxiv-2406-01719.title: Imputation of Missing Photometric Data and Photometric Redshift Estimation for CSST 2015 Imputation of Missing Photometric Data and Photometric Redshift Estimation for CSST – References
arxiv-2406-01719.creator: Zhijian Luo, Zhirui Tang, Zhu Chen, Liping Fu, Wei Du, Shaohua Zhang, Yan Gong, Chenggang Shu, Junhao Lu, Yicheng Li, Xian-Min Meng, Xingchen Zhou, Zuhui Fan
arxiv-2406-01719.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Zhijian Luo, Zhirui Tang, Zhu Chen, Liping Fu, Wei Du, Shaohua Zhang, Yan Gong, Chenggang Shu, Junhao Lu, Yicheng Li, Xian-Min Meng, Xingchen Zhou, Zuhui Fan. Accurate photometric redshift (photo- z z ) estimation requires support from multi-band observational data. However, in the actual process of astronomical observations and data processing, some sources may have missing observational data in certain bands for various reasons.

arxiv-2502-19508.title: Low-energy neutron cross-talk between organic scintillator detectors
arxiv-2502-19508.creator: M. Sénoville, F. Delaunay, N. L. Achouri, N. A. Orr, B. Carniol, N. de Séréville, D. Étasse, C. Fontbonne, J.-M. Fontbonne, J. Gibelin, J. Hommet, B. Laurent, X. Ledoux, F. M. Marqués, T. Martínez, M. Pârlog
arxiv-2502-19508.description: Abstract A series of measurements have been performed with low-energy monoenergetic neutrons to characterise cross-talk between two organic scintillator detectors. Cross-talk time-of-flight spectra and probabilities were determined for neutron energies from 1.4 to 15.5 MeV and effective scattering angles ranging from ∼ \sim 50 ∘ to ∼ \sim 100 ∘ .

arxiv-2505-24068.title: DiffCoTune: Differentiable Co-Tuning for Cross-domain Robot Control
arxiv-2505-24068.creator: Lokesh Krishna, Sheng Cheng, Junheng Li, Naira Hovakimyan, Quan Nguyen
arxiv-2505-24068.description: Abstract The deployment of robot controllers is hindered by modeling discrepancies due to necessary simplifications for computational tractability or inaccuracies in data-generating simulators. Such discrepancies typically require ad-hoc tuning to meet the desired performance, thereby ensuring successful transfer to a target domain.

arxiv-2507-10018.title: Crossover in the Ordered Phase in the Non-Mermin-Wagner-Hohenberg Regime of Spin Models with Long-Range Coupling
arxiv-2507-10018.creator: Jiewei Ding, Jiahao Su, Ho-Kin Tang, Wing Chi Yu
arxiv-2507-10018.description: Abstract Continuous spin models with long-range interactions of the form r − σ r^{-\sigma} , where r r is the distance between two spins and σ \sigma controls the decay of the interaction, exhibit enhanced order that competes with thermal disturbances, leading to a richer variety of phases and types of phase transitions.

arxiv-2509-22620.title: Voting-Bloc Entropy: A New Metric for DAO Decentralization
arxiv-2509-22620.creator: Andrés Fábrega, Amy Zhao, Jay Yu, James Austgen, Sarah Allen, Kushal Babel, Mahimna Kelkar, Ari Juels
arxiv-2509-22620.description: Abstract Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) use smart contracts to foster communities working toward common goals. Existing definitions of decentralization, however—the ‘D’ in DAO—fall short of capturing the key properties characteristic of diverse and equitable participation. This work proposes a new framework for measuring DAO decentralization called V oting- B loc E ntropy ( VBE , pronounced “vibe”).

arxiv-2512-08725.title: Spatio-Temporal Shifting to Reduce Carbon, Water, and Land-Use Footprints of Cloud Workloads
arxiv-2512-08725.creator: Giulio Attenni, Youssef Moawad, Novella Bartolini, Lauritz Thamsen
arxiv-2512-08725.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the potential of spatial and temporal cloud workload shifting to reduce carbon, water, and land-use footprints. Specifically, we perform a simulation study using real-world data from multiple cloud providers (AWS and Azure) and workload traces for different applications (big data analytics and FaaS).

pmc-10573258.creator: Sijie Wang, Wen Chen, Xinyue Huang, Xuezheng Chen, De Li, Feng Yu, Yong Chen
pmc-10573258.description: As a kind of energy storage device, a flexible supercapacitor has the characteristics of high capacity, fast charge/discharge rate, good stability, portability and softness. Conductive polymer polypyrrole (PPy) can be used as an electrode material for supercapacitors due to its environmental friendliness, simple synthesis process, good conductivity and potential for large-scale production.

pmc-10696166.title: Sexual experiences of postmenopausal women in China: a qualitative study
pmc-10696166.creator: Jie Chen, Haina Zhai, Hongyun Jin, Xiang Li, Pan Zhang, Rong Chen
pmc-10696166.description: BackgroundSexual dysfunction is common among postmenopausal women and can have a significant negative impact on quality of life.AimThis study aimed to explore perceptions, experiences, and coping strategies related to sex among postmenopausal women in China.MethodsWe used phenomenologic qualitative methods in this study.

pmc-11316483.title: Cross-Lagged Panel Networks of Sleep Inertia Across Its Distinct Change Patterns Among Intern Nurses with Shift Work in China

pmc-11316483.description: PurposeAlthough experimental psychopathology using PET, EEG, and fMRI is at the forefront of understanding the underlying mechanisms of sleep inertia, many questions concerning causality remain unanswerable due to ethical constraints and the use of small and heterogeneous samples in experimental methods.

pmc-11351244.title: The Role of Epithelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition Transcription Factors (EMT-TFs) in Acute Myeloid Leukemia Progression
pmc-11351244.creator: Diego Cuevas, Roberto Amigo, Adolfo Agurto, Adan Andreu Heredia, Catherine Guzmán, Antonia Recabal-Beyer, Valentina González-Pecchi, Teresa Caprile, Jody J Haigh, Carlos Farkas, Alessandra Sperotto
pmc-11351244.description: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a diverse malignancy originating from myeloid progenitor cells, with significant genetic and clinical variability. Modern classification systems like those from the World Health Organization (WHO) and European LeukemiaNet use immunophenotyping, molecular genetics, and clinical features to categorize AML subtypes.

pmc-11460960.title: Follicular cell-derived thyroid carcinomas harboring novel genetic BRAFNON-V600E mutations: real-world data obtained using a multigene panel

The patients’ clinical and pathological data were collected.

pmc-11492576.title: Massive citizen science sampling and integrated taxonomic approach unravel Danish cryptogam-dwelling tardigrade fauna
pmc-11492576.creator: Piotr Gąsiorek, Martin V Sørensen, Marie Rathcke Lillemark, Frederik Leerhøi, Anders P Tøttrup
pmc-11492576.description: Tardigrade diversity and distribution are enigmatic in most parts of the globe, and only some European countries can boast of a relatively well-studied water bear fauna. However, even these suffer from the lack of genetic data, which would substantiate faunistic data and make biogeographic comparisons easier.

pmc-11676262.creator: Fei Zhang, Yao Zhang, Zhuoxia Li, Xiaoxiao Wu, Dong Wang, Youling He, Hong Cheng, Baolei Fan, Dan Zhu, Min Li, Ben Zhong Tang, Takuya Terai, Haiying Liu
pmc-11676262.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Lipid droplets (LDs), once regarded as inert fat particles, have been ignored by scientific researchers for a long time. Now, studies have shown that LDs are dynamic organelles used to store neutral lipids in cells and maintain cell stability. The abnormality of intracellular LDs usually causes metabolic disorders in the body, such as obesity, atherosclerosis, diabetes, and cancer, so the LDs have attracted wide attention.

uslaw-usc-t18-s921.title: 18 U.S.C. § 921 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t18-s921.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s921.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 44 (Firearms). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) As used in this chapter— (1) The term “person” and the term “whoever” include any individual, corporation, company, association, firm, partnership, society, or joint stock company. (2) The term “interstate or foreign commerce” includes commerce between any place in a State.
